comments.author: Roach_76
comments.body_html:
How do you change the penetration on ammo types?

Do you just change the pen number in the json, or is there a specific way to go about it?

comments.author: EmperorGilgamesh
comments.body_html:
The way I did it was creating an ammunition.json file in the itemStats folder, following the same override logic as the other jsons in there. Since I wanted to customise every round independently, I just manually pasted every ID from the extra folder (praise be the author for including that one) and adjusted the pen to my liking.

Example:

{ “Enabled”: true, “Overrides”: { “5fd20ff893a8961fc660a954”: { “Ops”: { “PenetrationPower”: { “Op”: “multiply”, “Value”: 0.7 } } }, } }
